R8 results are recomputed at accept and by recompute, never on a read: read answers the stored results with computed_at and the method version; accept is refused CALC_RECOMPUTE_DIFFERS naming the differing result when a stored result was tampered, and a refused accept, by this or any other refusal, writes nothing, its recompute status and record included; recompute answers {agrees, results} and writes only the recompute status
